description: Source code implementing the google_breakpad::DwarfCFIToModule class, including register name mappings for various architectures, and methods for handling DWARF Call Frame Information (CFI) rules and entries.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule
classes.description: Class handling DWARF Call Frame Information translation to Breakpad format.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule::RegisterNames
classes.description: Namespace-like class providing register name mappings for different CPU architectures.

classes.name: DwarfCFIToModule::Reporter
classes.description: Nested class for reporting issues during DWARF CFI translation.

methods.name: MakeVector
methods.description: Creates a vector of strings from an array of C strings.

methods.name: I386
methods.description: Returns register names for x86 architecture.

methods.name: X86_64
methods.description: Returns register names for x86-64 architecture.

methods.name: ARM
methods.description: Returns register names for ARM architecture.

methods.name: ARM64
methods.description: Returns register names for ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: MIPS
methods.description: Returns register names for MIPS architecture.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Initializes a new stack frame entry with given parameters.

methods.name: RegisterName
methods.description: Returns the register name for a given register index.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a rule for a register at a specific address.

methods.name: UndefinedRule
methods.description: Handles an undefined register rule (not supported).

methods.name: SameValueRule
methods.description: Records a 'same value' rule for a register.

methods.name: OffsetRule
methods.description: Records an offset rule for a register.

methods.name: ValOffsetRule
methods.description: Records a value offset rule for a register.

methods.name: RegisterRule
methods.description: Records a register rule for a register.

methods.name: ExpressionRule
methods.description: Handles a register rule with a DWARF expression (not supported).

methods.name: ValExpressionRule
methods.description: Handles a register rule with a DWARF expression (not supported).

methods.name: End
methods.description: Finalizes the current stack frame entry.
